values.note: Individual sites are first come, first served; the fee is paid online on the day of arrival (or at a state park ranger station) before taking a site, with no envelopes on site. Only the four group camps are reservable on ReserveMN.

values.note: Minnesota state forest drive-in campsite, taxes included. Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

note: Ann Lake Campground in the 225-acre Bob Dunn Recreation Area, Sand Dunes State Forest near Zimmerman. Loop road is rough/sandy — plan a smaller rig. Four group camps are reservable; the Sand Dunes horse camp next door is busy on summer weekends. Ann Lake's sandy beach, fishing pier and day-use area are a short walk east of the loops. --Claude
summary: DNR facility record + map + fee page read: 36 rustic sites, vault toilets, drinking water, $17 incl. tax paid online same-day; individual sites are first-come only (ReserveMN carries only the 4 group camps), so booking derived 'reservable/some_sites' -> not reservable/always. Not waterfront kept. Pin is ~700 m north of the loops. No season or rig length stated.
